Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 23-Dec-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIFTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - DEC 25/JAN 26  
  SUBJECT: ECE 3121/ECE_3121 ANALOG AND DIGITAL COMMUNICATION  
  (SPL: ELECTRONICS & COMMUNICATION ENGINEERING)  
  ANALOG AND DIGITAL COMMUNICATION [ECE 3121]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
Missing data may be suitably assumed.  
  
1A)               Describe with neat diagrams the scheme for generation and demodulation of VSB modulated wave. (5)  
  Derive the spectrum of the demodulated signal v0(t) highlighting the condition of the transfer  
  function H(f). Draw the spectrum of product modulator output v(t) in the demodulation scheme and  
  the spectrum of demodulated signal v0(t).  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
1B)               Derive the expression of a wideband FM signal starting from the instantaneous frequency relation, (3)  
  and show how Bessel functions describe its spectrum.  
  (i) A 5 kHz audio signal with frequency deviation of 75 kHz is transmitted using FM. Using Carson's  
  Rule, calculate the approximate bandwidth required.  
  (ii) Recalculate the bandwidth if the frequency deviation is increased to 100 kHz. Compare and  
  comment on the effect of frequency deviation on bandwidth.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"

3A)   Consider the binary data sequence 1 0 0 0 1 1 0 1 which is applied to the input of a duo binary        (5)  
  system.  
  (i) Determine the output of the duo-binary coder and the corresponding receiver output, without a  
  precoder.  
  (ii) Determine the output of the duo-binary coder and the corresponding receiver output, with a  
  precoder.  
  Assume reference bit to be 1.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3B)   Derive the autocorrelation function of the bipolar NRZ code format. Assume statistically               (3)  
  independent and equally likely message bits.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
3C)   With a neat diagram explain the working principle of Delta modulation (DM transmitter) system.         (2)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
4A)   Derive the expression for Nyquist criterion for distortionless baseband transmission. Also discuss     (5)  
  the ideal solution for the same ,with the help of relevant mathematical representations and figures.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4B)   Derive the expression for the average probability of symbol error for coherent binary PSK detection (3)  
  with all intermediate steps. Assume AWGN channel.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4C)   The binary data sequence 0 1 1 1 1 0 0 1 is applied to the input of a DPSK transmitter. Determine      (2)  
  the differentially encoded sequence and transmitted phase. Assume initial reference bit as 1  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5A)   Construct minimum variance Huffman code for the given source probabilities pk =[0.26, 0.34, 0.1,       (5)  
  0.13, 0.17]. Also determine the average code length of this Huffman code.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5B)   Determine the entropy, efficiency and redundancy of the Huffman code as given in Q5A.                  (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  Page #2

5C)                   Determine the minimum variance of this Huffman code as given in Q5A.                               (2)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"
